title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Jean-Jacques Wondo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
part_text: 7. Notes that for many years, EU policies in the DRC have prioritised the reform of the security forces and the justice sector, aiming at reducing state predation of the population; refers to Special Report No 9/2013 of the European Court of Auditors that criticised the limited effectiveness of the EU’s EUR 1.9 billion aid to the DRC in the 2003-2011 period and the DRC’s weak commitment to justice reform; calls for the EU not to continue to finance a justice system that is still driven by corruption and coercion;
